news.title: FCA Settlement Ends HTX’s Active UK Business
news.body: The FCA announced an October 29 settlement with Huobi Global S.A., securing High Court undertakings concerning unlawful UK cryptoasset promotions. HTX no longer operates actively in the UK: consumers cannot deposit, new UK users cannot register, and the platform cannot target or solicit UK consumers. The settlement does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing.

news.title: PhotonPay Raises $40 Million for Stablecoin-Centered Financial Infrastructure
news.body: Blockchain Capital led PhotonPay’s $40 million Series C, with SBI Group joining as a new investor. PhotonPay says it will use the funding to expand local clearing, global card issuing, embedded finance and automated execution capabilities within its stablecoin-centered financial platform.

news.title: Monzo Launches in Spain, Its First Continental European Market
news.body: Spain marks Monzo’s first market launch in continental Europe, extending the bank’s geographic footprint. The launch brings Monzo into competition for Spanish customers’ accounts and everyday banking activity; the supplied coverage does not quantify funded accounts, salary deposits or payment usage.

news.title: Wealthsimple Raises $302 Million as Checking Openings Surpass Investing
news.body: Wealthsimple raised US$302 million at a US$9.8 billion valuation. The company said new checking-account openings exceeded new investment-account openings for the first time in the second quarter, marking a shift in account acquisition beyond its original investment offering. The figures do not establish how many customers use Wealthsimple as their primary bank.

news.title: Galaxy Applies for Federal Trust Charter Without Deposit-Taking Powers
news.body: Galaxy Digital applied to the OCC for a national trust bank charter to bring digital-asset custody, trading, staking and fiduciary investment advisory services under a single federal framework. The proposed structure builds on more than 50 existing licences. Galaxy still needs OCC approval, and the charter would not permit deposit-taking or commercial lending.

perspective: Monzo’s Spain launch and Wealthsimple’s shift toward checking highlight expansion in everyday banking alongside funding and regulatory developments in digital assets.

curiosity.text: Singapore launched PayNow domestically in 2017. Singapore and Thailand linked PayNow and PromptPay in 2021, allowing users to send money between the countries using recipients’ mobile numbers rather than bank-account details. Source: Monetary Authority of Singapore, “PayNow” — https://www.mas.gov.sg/development/fintech/paynow
